subject: Commit clarity required — pricing exceptions impacting June forecast (Nebula)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit clarity required — pricing exceptions impacting June forecast (Nebula)

Team —

Quick heads up on Nebula (DEAL-2026-0347): procurement came back this morning with two nonstandard asks that change the economics materially (extended Net-60 payment + a 20% multiline discount on inference units). Sales marked this as a potential commit for June but Deal Desk hasn't signed off yet. Finance needs a final decision to know whether we can include this in the June committed forecast.

Status request / asks:
- Karthik: can Deal Desk approve the combination of Net-60 + 20% multi-line discount? If not, what alternative concession do you recommend to preserve the commit?
- Vanessa: what is the close cadence on getting the SOW signed? Procurement says they want contractual SLA credits spelled out before signing — I attached their redlines.
- Laura: if Deal Desk approves a conditional concession, can Finance mark the deal as "Committed - conditional" for forecasting purposes, or do you need a firm sign?

Deadline: we need a clear call by EOD Monday (2026-06-28) to decide whether this belongs in the June committed number. If we miss that, revenue will need to roll to July.

Attachments: Nebula_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf, pricing_matrix_proposed.xlsx

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Manager, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit clarity required — pricing exceptions impacting June forecast (Nebula)

On Thu, Jun 25, 2026 at 08:12 AM Soojin Lee wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick heads up on Nebula (DEAL-2026-0347): procurement came back this morning with two nonstandard asks...

Adding context from the AE: Nebula is locked on Redwood for a multi-cluster pilot (12 months), ARR lines look good, but procurement is pushing hard on payment and discount. They flagged SLA/credits as a non-negotiable from their legal team.

What I did: looped in Legal for the SLA language; asked AE to push for Net-30 as our baseline. Karthik, Deal Desk will need the commercial fallback if we can't give Net-60 + full 20% stack.

Proposed interim approach (to keep forecast hygiene):
- Mark as "Commit - pending contract" in our forecast with conditional note: "1) SOW in circulation; 2) Deal Desk to approve concession by 06/28; 3) If not approved, assume signed amount = list price."
- If Finance is okay with conditional commit, we'll move it into June numbers but label for AR follow-up.

I attached the AE's summary and the current SOW redlines.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: James Lee <james.lee@nebula-corp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit clarity required — pricing exceptions impacting June forecast (Nebula)

Vanessa / Soojin —

Thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from procurement/finance at Nebula:
- Net-60 is necessary for our internal cash-flow alignment; Net-30 is a hard ask from Redwood, but we could consider Net-45 if you can provide a small early-pay discount or payment milestone tied to pilot acceptance.
- The 20% discount is a consolidated ask across two product lines (inference + observability) for our integrated usage forecast. If Redwood cannot provide the full 20%, we would consider a blended discount that approximates the same TCO over 12 months.

We'd like to keep timeline tight — legal is ready to sign as soon as the commercial terms are agreed.

James Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager, Nebula Corp
finance+contracts@nebula-corp.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit clarity required — pricing exceptions impacting June forecast (Nebula)

Folks —

I reviewed the ask with Deal Desk and Legal. Bottom line: we can agree to a blended concession that hits ~15% effective discount across the two lines and move payment terms to Net-45 with a 1.5% early-pay incentive at Net-30. Conditions:
- Approval is limited to this specific SOW and cannot be reused across other Nebula entities.
- SLA credits must stay within the standard tabled limits; Legal will not accept an open-ended SLA credit.
- Acceptance criteria for the pilot (documented in the SOW) must be met to trigger full payment schedule.

If Sales can accept these guardrails, Deal Desk will sign off by EOD Monday (06/28). Please confirm — I'll push the approved pricing matrix as an attachment once finalized.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachment: pricing_matrix_approved.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit clarity required — pricing exceptions impacting June forecast (Nebula)

Thanks all —

Per Karthik's note and the attached approved pricing matrix, Finance will accept this as a conditional commit for the June forecast with the following coding and caveats:
- Forecast status: "Committed - conditional" (DEAL-2026-0347)
- Committed ARR: $1,040,000 (effective post-concession) — include in June committed number but flag to AR as "verify on invoice"
- Revenue recognition: only after signed SOW and successful pilot acceptance per SOW clause 4.2. If SOW isn't signed by 07/07, we will remove the commit in the next forecast refresh.

Please ensure DocuSign is routed to finance@redwood.ai and that the SOW contains the acceptance criteria Karthik referenced. Once signed, I'll move it to "Committed - firm" and lock the number.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Attachments received: pricing_matrix_approved.xlsx
